sources.title: AI Model Efficiency Toolkit (AIMET) - GitHub
sources.snippet: AI Model Efficiency Toolkit (AIMET) AIMET is a software toolkit for quantizing trained ML models. AIMET improves the runtime performance of deep learning models by reducing compute load and memory footprint. Models quantized with AIMET facilitate its deployment on edge devices like mobile phones or laptops by reducing memory footprint.
